notes.title: v0.2.11 - Big balance update!
notes.notes:
We've got a big update for y'all today! The biggest is probably the balance. Folks have been saying that it feels "too easy" or "too slow". Well, we've rebalanced a lot so it will be more of a challenge. Lean on those permanent upgrades to help you out! We welcome feedback on this change, and anything else.

We'll be posting a Roadmap soon of features/tweaks that will be coming up. Feedback is welcome!

Here's a list of alllll of the changes today!
[list]
[*] [b]Rebalanced XP needed to level[/b], which has changed the difficulty of the game. We would love your feedback on this.
[*] [b]Tracking which attack slot hit the enemy last[/b], and if the attack is different it will do damage.
[*] Can now [b]damage enemies in knockback[/b] state.
[*] Bosses can no longer be knocked past the borders of the room, and will not spawn inside the wall.
[*] Tweaked Divine Beam to target random on screen enemy that can be damaged (instead of the nearest) and extended the maximum distance it can travel, how long it can last, plus removed the pierce damage reduction. The distance and how long it can last will be affected by projectile count.
[*] Added [b]Steam screenshot[/b] ability.
[*] Added more details to Levelup Menu for equipment.
[*] Added local backup saves and [b]tweaked load script[/b] to give preference to the most recent save file (Steam Cloud/local).
[*] Increased the chance for towns to spawn per timer.
[*] Changed how % appears in the perm upgrades menu (it will show +25% instead of 125%). This does not affect the actual values, just the way they are written.
[*] Fixed bug with red X on the levelend screen when area boss defeated.
[*] Fixed bug with pause and Steam Overlay.
[*] [b]Added Banish secret[/b], and menu in titlescreen, plus permanent upgrades to increase the count, when unlocked.
[*] Added [b]area Enemy Overload secrets[/b].
[*] Added transparency to Magic Cards base and evo attacks.
[/list]

Thanks everyone for playing!

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: Announcing Early Access Release Date - August 25, 2023!!!
notes.notes:
We are SO THRILLED to announce the [b]Early Access release date[/b] for Elemental Survivors: coming [b]August 25, 2023[/b]!!!

To celebrate we've added some exciting new stuff, plus some basic fixes:
[list]
[*] Evos! Yes! [b]Attack evolutions![/b] Check out the secrets menu to see what all you need to do to get these started, and how to get more. *you start with 1 available per round; more will be available to unlock and purchase in Early Access
[*] Lots more [b]minidiscs[/b]! Check out the secrets menu to find out how to get them all.
[*] [b]Increased coin drops [/b]from torches.
[*] No more coin pull at the end of runs (you'll get plenty during the level, don't worry).
[*] [b]Bombs[/b] now work differently... check them out!
[*] [b]Backslash[/b] is now the Shadowless Slash and aims (manual aim direction or auto aim nearest enemy) with a follow up projectile for each combo.
[*] Some balance tweaks for attacks, including cooldowns and damage.
[*] Returning from the endgame screen no longer directs you to the permanent upgrades menu.
[*] Some fun effects when you get a max chest.
[*] [b]Some attacks can destroy enemy projectiles.[/b]
[*] Max 5 magnets can be on the field at one time.
[*] Fixed glitch with tornado animations not disappearing.
[*] More perm upgrade levels to purchase.
[*] Broadstrike now aims (manual aim direction or auto aim nearest enemy, to the right or left).
[*] Some new sound effects for attacks, plus player death sound effect, and some enemy spawn sound effects.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these additions and would love to hear your thoughts, here or in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FPFAjbWryh]Discord[/url]!

Have a lovely week and happy blending!! 

<3 <3 The Samobee Team
